Core viewing and rock sawing facilities are available Monday - Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. To see information on the status of our drill core program and download forms for accessing the collection, visit [https://yukon.ca/en/yukon-geological-survey-core-library](https://yukon.ca/en/yukon-geological-survey-core-library) .

To reserve the core library facilities, please contact [YGS-Minerals@yukon.ca](mailto:YGS-Minerals@yukon.ca)

For comments or feedback on the dataset, please contact [ygstech@yukon.ca](mailto:ygstech@yukon.ca)

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
